highlights: Earn up to 20 points per dollar at 10Xcelerator merchants for spending up to S$16,000; 5 points per dollar with Singapore Airlines (SIA) and Scoot, and a base rate of 2 points per dollar on all other spending.
pros: Enjoy competitive rates and complimentary benefits at over 1,600 Fine Hotels + Resorts properties worldwide.
pros: Up to 6 dining experiences for your and your loved ones across the year with Table for Two by Platinum
pros: Complimentary access to over 1,550 lounges across 500 airports in 140 countries.
pros: Gain instant status to higher tiers of leading hotel loyalty programs.
pros: Complimentary Access into Tower Club.
pros: Membership Rewards Points never expire.
pros: Up to 50% savings at premium dining locations with Love Dining.
cons: Annual fee: S$1,744 (inclusive of GST).

extra.description: Made for luxury living and travel, taste the high life with the American Express Platinum Charge Card, with accelerated points earn rates, unlimited airport lounge access for you and one guest each, complimentary hotel upgrades and stays, and much much more.
